_about: Towns near Wigan that get their own page at /areas/<slug>/. Built by scripts/build.mjs with pages/_town.html. Dropped kerb facts were read from each council's own page on 16 Oct 2026; check them again if a council changes its process.

wigan.name: Wigan Council
wigan.kerb: Yes, if you'll drive over the pavement to get onto the drive, and in {town} that goes through Wigan Council. You apply with their vehicle crossing form and they reply within 20 working days. If it's approved, they take a deposit and build the crossing themselves. On an A, B or C road you need planning permission first, and council tenants need written permission from their estates manager.

sthelens.name: St Helens Council
sthelens.kerb: Yes, if you'll drive over the pavement to get onto the drive. In {town} you apply to St Helens Council. They assess it and send a free quote, and the crossing can be built by the council or by a contractor. On an A, B or C road you may need planning permission first. It can take a while, so it's worth applying early.

lancs.name: Lancashire County Council
lancs.kerb: Yes, if you'll drive over the pavement to get onto the drive. {town} is in Lancashire, so it goes through Lancashire County Council rather than the local borough council. You apply online, and if it's approved they send you a list of approved contractors to get prices from. On an A, B or C road you'll need planning permission first.

bolton.name: Bolton Council
bolton.kerb: Yes, if you'll drive over the pavement to get onto the drive. In {town} that goes through Bolton Council, which builds every domestic crossing itself, so you contact their highways team rather than booking a contractor. On an A, B or C road you need planning permission first.

warrington.name: Warrington Borough Council
warrington.kerb: Yes, if you'll drive over the pavement to get onto the drive. In Warrington you apply to Warrington Borough Council. They can do the work, or give permission for your own contractor. Your drive needs to be at least 5 metres from the house to the boundary so the car doesn't hang over the pavement, and on an A, B or C road you need planning permission first.

towns.name: Standish
towns.intro: Standish and Shevington are just up the road from us in Wigan. We lay driveways, patios and fencing right across WN6, from the village centre out to Standish Lower Ground.

towns.name: Orrell
towns.intro: Orrell is on the west side of Wigan, a few minutes from us. We lay drives and patios across Orrell and Kitt Green, and down towards Pemberton.

towns.name: Hindley
towns.intro: Hindley is just east of Wigan. We lay driveways and patios across Hindley, Hindley Green, Platt Bridge, Abram and Bickershaw.

towns.name: Ashton-in-Makerfield
towns.intro: Ashton-in-Makerfield is a short drive south of Wigan. We lay driveways and patios across Ashton and Bryn.

towns.name: Leigh
towns.intro: Leigh is in the east of the Wigan borough. We lay driveways and patios across Leigh, Pennington, Westleigh and Bedford.

towns.name: Atherton
towns.intro: Atherton sits between Hindley and Tyldesley, on the east side of the Wigan borough. We lay driveways, patios and fencing all over Atherton.

towns.name: Tyldesley
towns.intro: Tyldesley and Astley are on the Manchester side of the Wigan borough. We lay driveways and patios across both.

towns.name: Golborne
towns.intro: Golborne and Lowton are at the south end of the Wigan borough, near the M6. We lay driveways and patios across both.

towns.name: Skelmersdale
towns.intro: Skelmersdale and Up Holland are just over the border in West Lancashire, a short drive from Wigan. We lay driveways and patios all over Skem and Up Holland.

towns.name: Ormskirk
towns.intro: Ormskirk is out in West Lancashire, west of Wigan. We lay driveways and patios in Ormskirk, Aughton and Burscough.

towns.name: St Helens
towns.intro: St Helens is south-west of Wigan. We lay driveways and patios across the town and the villages around it, including Haydock, Rainford, Billinge and Thatto Heath.

towns.name: Newton-le-Willows
towns.intro: Newton-le-Willows and Earlestown are between Wigan and Warrington. We lay driveways and patios across both.

towns.name: Chorley
towns.intro: Chorley is north of Wigan, in Lancashire. We lay driveways and patios across Chorley, Adlington, Coppull and Euxton.

towns.name: Westhoughton
towns.intro: Westhoughton is the nearest part of Bolton to us, just east of Wigan. We lay driveways and patios across Westhoughton, Daisy Hill and Wingates.

towns.name: Horwich
towns.intro: Horwich and Blackrod sit below Rivington Pike, north-east of Wigan. We lay driveways and patios across both.

towns.name: Bolton
towns.intro: Bolton is east of Wigan. We lay driveways and patios across the town, from Heaton and Deane to Harwood, Breightmet, Farnworth and Bromley Cross.

towns.name: Warrington
towns.intro: Warrington is south of Wigan, down the M6. We lay driveways and patios across the town, including Great Sankey, Penketh, Orford, Birchwood and Stockton Heath.
